newsitem.title: USA: DuPont Photomasks sees Q4 below consensus.
newsitem.headline: DuPont Photomasks sees Q4 below consensus.

text.p: DuPont Photomasks Inc on Friday said it expected earnings in the fourth quarter, ended June 30, to fall 12 to 16 percent short of analysts' estimates, though revenues would meet expectations.
The First Call consensus estimate for the company's fourth quarter is $0.63 per share.

The company said projected fourth-quarter earnings would fail to meet earlier expectations because of international expansion costs and higher research and development expenses, mainly reflecting the start-up of its Reticle Technology Center.

"During the fourth quarter, we added leading-edge capacity in France and Korea, started ramping operations in China, and ramped up manpower additions and construction of our new factory in Scotland," the company's chief executive, J. Michael Hardinger, said. It was those costs that contributed to the earnings shortfall versus expectations, he said.
The company said it expected to release its earnings for fiscal 1997 and the fourth quarter on July 30.
